name: save-buffer-clear-bridge-and-count
body: Two limits on the rewritten save. (1) It still clears the in-memory admission list (`self.buffer.clear()`) purely so `end` and `pending_changes_message`, which still gate on that list, can release a saved session; drop that line when phase-2 task-14 moves `end` onto the database's pending state, and again with phase-3 task-7 when the field itself goes. (2) The save's stdout count is now writes plus deletes rather than the old list length (`Session saved: N change(s) in one commit`), and no test pins the number — the client reply is the fixed `Session saved` — so re-pin it if the count ever becomes contract.
